query:
SELECT
                h.step_slots IS NULL
                OR h.step_slots > (
                    SELECT count(*)
                    FROM factory_step s
                    JOIN factory_run r ON r.id = s.run_id
                    WHERE s.machine_id = h.id
                        AND s.ended_at IS NULL
                        AND r.ended_at IS NULL
                        AND s.started_at > now() - make_interval(secs => $4)
                        AND NOT (s.run_id = $2 AND s.seq = $3)
                ) AS "free!"
            FROM harnesses h
            WHERE h.id = $1
